_comment: IRF & BG calibration step. AutoForm over CalibrationViewModel: pick a detector, set its IRF file, convolution range (start/stop) and background (kHz) against a live decay/IRF plot (custom `decay_conv` section, draggable range). Apply transfers the per-detector calibration to Phasor + pixel-wise MLE. Optional/skippable (after N&B, before Phasor).

sections.label: Detector
sections.description: Detector to calibrate (settings are per detector).

sections.title: IRF files (this detector)
sections.description: IRF TTTR file(s) for this detector (summed); carried to Phasor + pixel-wise MLE. Drag-drop to add.

sections.label: Conv start
sections.description: Convolution/fit window start (micro-time channel). Drag the blue region.

sections.label: Conv stop
sections.description: Convolution/fit window stop (micro-time channel). Drag the blue region.

sections.label: IRF start
sections.description: IRF window start (separate from the conv window). Drag the green region.

sections.label: IRF stop
sections.description: IRF window stop (separate from the conv window). Drag the green region.

sections.label: Background VV (∥)
sections.description: Parallel-channel background subtracted from the VV IRF (0 = auto baseline).

sections.label: Background VH (⊥)
sections.description: Perpendicular-channel background subtracted from the VH IRF (0 = auto baseline).

sections.label: Shift VV (∥, ch)
sections.description: Circular (wrap-around) shift of the VV IRF, in micro-time channels.

sections.label: Shift VH (⊥, ch)
sections.description: Circular (wrap-around) shift of the VH IRF, in micro-time channels.

buttons.label: Apply →
buttons.description: Transfer IRF / convolution-range / background to Phasor and MLE.

sections.title: Decay & IRF
sections.description: Data + IRF decay (semilog) with a draggable convolution range and background line.
